sn22.44:1.2: vo bhikkhave desissāmi sakkāyanirodhagāminiṃ ca paṭipadaṃ ||
sn22.44:1.4: Katamā ca bhikkhave sakkāya samudayagāminī paṭipadā || || 5
sn22.44:1.5: Idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānam adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.44:1.6: rūpam attato samanupassati || rūpavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā rūpam rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || 6-8
sn22.44:1.10: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || || 10
sn22.44:1.11: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadāti ||
sn22.44:1.12: Iti idam bhikkhave vuccati dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanāti
sn22.44:2.2: Idha bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.44:2.3: na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantaṃ vā attānam na attani vā rūpam na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || || 13-15
sn22.44:2.7: Na viññāṇam attato samanupassati || na viññāvantam vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇam na viññāṇasmim vā attānaṃ || || 17
sn22.44:2.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti || ||
sn22.44:2.9: Iti hidam bhikkhave vuccati dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā ti
